definitions.explanation: Describing a person, ability, or achievement that is exceptionally good, particularly in academic, professional, or competitive contexts.

examples.japanese: {優秀|ゆうしゅう}な{学生|がくせい}。
{彼|かれ}は{成績|せいせき}が{優秀|ゆうしゅう}だ。
{優秀|ゆうしゅう}な{人材|じんざい}を{確保|かくほ}するために、{給与|きゅうよ}{体系|たいけい}を{見直|みなお}した。
examples.english: We revised the salary structure in order to secure talented personnel.

notes:
A な-adjective from the noun {優秀|ゆうしゅう}, composed of {優|ゆう} (superior, gentle) + {秀|しゅう} (excel, outstanding). One of the most common words for praising someone's abilities or achievements.

USAGE:
Used mainly for people and their abilities or work. Less commonly applied to physical objects. Often appears in formal evaluations, academic contexts, and business language. Can be used as a noun modifier ({優秀|ゆうしゅう}な{人材|じんざい}) or as a predicate ({成績|せいせき}が{優秀|ゆうしゅう}だ).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {優秀|ゆうしゅう}な{人材|じんざい} — talented personnel
- {優秀|ゆうしゅう}な{成績|せいせき} — excellent grades
- {優秀|ゆうしゅう}{賞|しょう} — excellence award
- {成績|せいせき}{優秀者|ゆうしゅうしゃ} — top achiever, honors student

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {優|すぐ}れた — excellent, superior (broader usage; can describe things and qualities)
- {有能|ゆうのう}な — competent, capable (emphasizes practical ability over academic achievement)
- {秀逸|しゅういつ}な — superb, exceptional (more literary; often for creative works)
